correctness.rationale: For every contraction singular spectrum in [0,1], the normalized width deficit equals E H(sum_j(1-s_j^2) U_j^2). Superadditivity of strictly convex H and the sharp chord inequality for q_x(s)=sqrt(1-x+xs^2) give the pointwise lower bound sum_j(1-s_j) H(U_j^2). Beta integration yields exact gamma_n; strictness shows only orthogonal and rank-(n-1) partial isometries attain equality. Mirsky singular-value inequality proves the nuclear distance equals sum(1-s_j). All-dimensional proof is analytical; finite checker only supplementary.
